Specification: This module is a model-checking wrapper for a typed two-phase commit specification. It introduces the concrete set of resource managers RM, declares the state variables used by the protocol state, and instantiates another module named TwoPhaseTypedInv where the actual algorithm, actions, and properties are defined. This file itself does not define the protocol dynamics or temporal properties; it only fixes the RM set and exposes the variables for the instantiated specification.
